quarterly_data.signal: AAOI's 8-K: on May 8, 2026 AAOI entered three lease agreements for three industrial buildings in Houston, Texas intended for manufacturing, warehouse and office use: Building 1 (approximately 163,930 rentable square feet plus an approximately 3.34-acre adjacent tract), Building 2 (approximately 343,332 rentable square feet) and Building 3 (approximately 228,954 rentable square feet). Each lease has an initial term of 123 full calendar months and includes an option for AAOI to purchase the buildings.
